records.title: Myths of the Cherokee
ancientAuthors: Cherokee narrators, collected chiefly among Eastern Cherokee communities by James Mooney
records.translator: James Mooney (collector, editor, and English-language recorder)
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: Mooney collected chiefly among Eastern Cherokee communities in North Carolina during 1887–1890, with some material from western Cherokee communities. Individual stories and printed sources must remain distinguished; the 1902 ethnography is not a single pan-Cherokee canon or a source for current practice.
